reference_sql:
SELECT year(order_ts) AS order_year,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
GROUP BY year(order_ts)
alternatives: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM order_ts) AS order_year, COUNT(order_id) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1
SELECT year(date_trunc('year', order_ts)) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY date_trunc('year', order_ts)

other_way.sql: SELECT year(date_trunc('year', order_ts)) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY date_trunc('year', order_ts)
other_way.tradeoff: Grouping by the first day of the year from date_trunc works too, but year() gives the number in one step.
